source.author: lucan
source.text: Fatur, et astrictis laxari vincula palmis Imperat.
source.text_original: Fatur, et astrictis laxari vincula palmis / Imperat.
source.text_english: He speaks, and orders the bonds to be loosened from their bound hands.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, fatur et haec:
reuse.text_original: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, / obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, / fatur et haec:
reuse.text_english: Only that one, raging, stands in the way with women’s howls, as much as the Martian trumpet drowns the Idaean boxwood pipe; and she says this:
